justification: `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Configuration.java` is 731 lines and mixes several separable concerns: platform presets (`unix/osX/windows/forCurrentPlatform`), path normalization, disk sizing, attribute views/providers/defaults, roots/working-directory validation, feature flags, file-time source, and watch-service settings. The class also contains a nested `Builder` with 15 public mutators/build method, making the API broad rather than cohesive. `jimfs/src/test/java/com/google/common/jimfs/ConfigurationTest.java` exercises these as distinct behaviors, reinforcing that the class aggregates multiple responsibilities and could be split into smaller abstractions.
